description: This file provides a dependency function for a FastAPI application that retrieves the current user's ID from an authorization header containing a JWT. It handles authorization logic including token validation and error handling.

methods.name: uuid.UUID|None get_current_user_id( authorization: str | None = Header(default=None, description="Bearer token"), settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings), )
methods.description: Retrieves current user ID from Authorization header if authentication is enabled, returning UUID or raising UnauthorizedError on failure.
